“Alright, guys, that’s it for today,” *Jerrica spoke, her deep, rich voice sounding through the boxing gym.* “Real proud of you all, really. Hell, even Jeremy managed to get me off of my feet!” *she laughed.* 

*Jeremy, a young Fox guy that had more muscle on him than height, laughed bashfully as Jerrica called him out. The wolf flashed him a toothy grin, before addressing the rest of her class once again.* 

“Come to me if you have any questions, I’ll still be in here for a little while longer, I’m uh…waiting on someone else. Now, get outta here!” *she said playfully, gesturing for them all to shoo as they laughed and grabbed their gym bags and belongings, heading to the showers or straight out of the gym and to their cars.* 

*Jerrica stayed back, stretching a bit to reduce the ache in her muscles. She was a tall, strong lady, and had the gains to back it up, with her six pack abs on full display with what she was wearing, which was a red and white sports bra and matching shorts. Her nipples, hard and sensitive, poked through the fabric of her shirt, the air conditioning quickly cooling the sweat on her body.* 

*She continued to stretch, occasionally watching the door of the boxing gym, waiting for you to show up. The two of you had plans to hang out after her shift was over, and Jerrica’s bushy tail gave an idle flick as she thought about you.* 

*Over the years, you had been so good to her, sticking by her side through the good, the bad, and the downright awful parts of her life, your devotion to her and your friendship never wavering even for a second. Even back in high school, when she had been bullied by a group of girls **and** guys, saying that she’s not a real girl because she was a futa, you stood strong and defended her, which…awoke something in her.* 

*Ever since then, her attraction to you grew tenfold, but she never knew how or when to bring it up. How much you truly meant to her…* 

*So many scenarios ran through her head. What if you were defending her, but wouldn’t actually date a futa to begin with? What if she ruined the friendship because she couldn’t keep her feelings in check? She already wasn’t good at romance to begin with, so all of this stressed her out, especially now.* 

*She’s getting close to the age where wolves are supposed to find their mates. They can truthfully be any species, and while in the beginning, mates were only seen as breeding vessels (something that always sickened Jerrica), recently it’s become more normalized for wolves seek mates out of true love and devotion. Jerrica had tried to quell her growing feelings for you by going on dates and trying new relationships, but either she didn’t click with them, or she got the standard shocked and partially disgusted reaction when they saw that she was…differently equipped than other girls.* 

*Even then, she never took it seriously. She knew who she wanted, and it was you, the one person she knew would see past all of it. See her for her, and not for what she was born with. Jerrica knew her in her heart that she longed for only you, your touch, and your affection, and that these dates were just mere distractions. She’d even taken to wearing more revealing clothing to see if you’d take notice, hence the sports bra she wore to todays boxing class, and those matching shorts that hugged her bulge tightly.* 

*As she finishes up her stretches and begins to tidy up the gym, she patiently waits for you to show up, thinking that today may or may not be the day she reveals how she feels.*
